observation.visible_scene: A white ceramic cup with a floral decal (maroon and yellow blossoms, green leaves, red berry sprigs) and a gold band near the base sits on a slatted wooden table, handle pointing right. A softly blurred interior background (curtained window, an orange object, a dark wooden post on the right) stays constant. The cup itself is at rest throughout the excerpt; the only motion is faint white steam rising and drifting above its rim.
visible_changes: Steam is already present at the start and persists to the end, indicating an ongoing emission rather than an onset or completion.

The steam plume shifts position across frames: in early frames a wisp leans right of the rim (e.g. t=0.20s), in mid frames it appears over the left/center rim (e.g. t=0.80s, t=1.73s), and in later frames it drifts again, changing shape and vertical extent.
The cup's location relative to the table slats and to the background post does not change, so the cup is stationary.
The floral pattern, handle orientation, and gold rim line remain unchanged (no deformation, no rotation of the cup).
No editing cut is visible; the sequence reads as one continuous shot.
outside_clip_unknowns: What liquid fills the cup and the heat source are not visible.
Whether steam emission began before this segment or continues after it is unknown.
Any camera setup or intended framing change outside this crop is not shown.
uncertain_details: Any camera motion is at most negligible; the background and cup align consistently across frames, so the view is treated as essentially static.
The exact horizontal drift of the steam between frames is hard to track frame-by-frame due to its faintness; only its overall presence and shifting appearance are supported.
The identity of the beverage (coffee, tea, etc.) cannot be determined from the visible content.
